words.def: Absence is the state of something being away.
words.ex: There is an absence of sand in the hourglass.

words.def: If you say something aloud, you say it so that others can hear you.
words.ex: My father often reads stories aloud to me and my sister.

words.def: If someone is bald, they have no hair.
words.ex: My oldest brother is bald.

words.def: A blanket is a piece of cloth that you use to keep warm or to sit upon.
words.ex: I laid a blanket on the ground so that we could have a picnic.

words.def: To creep is to move quietly and slowly.
words.ex: The cat slowly crept down the tree.

words.def: Divorce is an event in which a marriage is ended.
words.ex: Divorce rates have increased in the past twenty years.

words.def: To imitate someone is to do exactly what they do.
words.ex: He imitated his favorite superhero by putting on a costume.

words.def: An infant is a baby.
words.ex: The infant cried all night.

words.def: To kidnap someone is to take them illegally.
words.ex: She was terrified to find out her son was kidnapped.

words.def: A nap is a short sleep, usually during the day.
words.ex: I took a short nap because I stayed up late last night.

words.def: You use nowhere to say that a place or thing does not exist.
words.ex: Unfortunately, water was nowhere to be found.

words.def: To pat something is to hit it softly with your hand.
words.ex: I patted some lotion onto my face.

words.def: Relief is a feeling you get when something bad or challenging ends.
words.ex: I felt a sense of relief when I heard the good news.

words.def: To reproduce is to make something exactly how someone else did it.
words.ex: The children tried to reproduce their house using toy blocks.

words.def: To rhyme is to have the same sounds at the end of a word.
words.ex: Humpty Dumpty is an old rhyme that children learn in school.

words.def: To suck is to put something in your mouth and try to get flavor out of it.
words.ex: The baby sucked milk from her bottle.

words.def: If something is urgent, it is important and needs to be done now.
words.ex: He had to leave now; it was urgent.

words.def: To vanish is to go away suddenly.
words.ex: All the passengers vanished from the train station.

words.def: A wagon is a cart you use to carry heavy things.
words.ex: He used his wagon to carry some of his gifts.

words.def: A wrinkle is a line on a person's face that happens as they get old.
words.ex: My grandfather has some wrinkles on his face.

story.title: Anna the Babysitter
paragraphs: Since her parents got a divorce, Anna has had to help her mother. In her mother's absence, Anna takes care of Grace, the baby. At first, Anna thought it was an easy job.

One afternoon, Anna played with Grace. She meowed like a cat and Grace imitated her. In fact, Grace reproduced every sound that Anna made. She took her sister outside. She put Grace in the wagon, but there was nowhere for them to go. So they went back inside.

Anna put the infant on the floor and went into her room. But when she came back, Grace had vanished! Anna looked everywhere, but she could not find her sister. Maybe the baby had been kidnapped! "Where are you?" Anna called aloud.
The situation was becoming urgent. She wanted to call her mom, but she didn't want her to think Anna couldn't do the job. Anna sat down. What was she going to do?

But then, Anna heard something. It was coming from her room. "Grace?" She got down on her knees and looked under the bed. She could see Grace's bald head. Grace had followed Anna into her room and crept under the bed.

She picked up her sister and patted her on the head. Her head was soft and had no wrinkles. Grace was sucking on her thumb and looked tired. So, Anna wrapped her in a blanket and sang rhymes for her. Then she put Grace in bed for a nap.
After that afternoon, Anna knew that taking care of Grace was not an easy job. It takes a lot of work to take care of a baby!

word_list_exercises.title: Exercise 1: Choose the right word for the given definition.

questions.content: 1. not having any hair
questions.explanation: bald (hói) nghĩa là không có tóc.

questions.content: 2. a good feeling when something bad goes away
questions.explanation: relief (sự nhẹ nhõm) là cảm giác tốt khi điều tồi tệ qua đi. (Lưu ý: 'roar' là từ sai trong sách, nhưng được giữ nguyên làm lựa chọn sai).

questions.content: 3. to put something in your mouth and get flavor from it
questions.explanation: suck (mút, ngậm) là hành động đặt một vật vào miệng để lấy hương vị.

questions.content: 4. to act like someone else
questions.explanation: imitate (bắt chước) là hành động giống người khác.

questions.content: 5. to go away suddenly
questions.explanation: vanish (biến mất) là biến mất một cách đột ngột.

word_list_exercises.title: Exercise 2: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: 1. What is it called when you don't have something?
questions.explanation: absence (sự thiếu vắng) là tình trạng không có cái gì đó.

questions.content: 2. This is another name for a baby.
questions.explanation: infant (trẻ sơ sinh) là một tên gọi khác của baby.

questions.content: 3. What could you use to carry wood?
questions.explanation: wagon (xe kéo) dùng để chở đồ nặng như gỗ.

questions.content: 4. Which of the following actions is a crime?
questions.explanation: kidnap (bắt cóc) là một tội ác.

questions.content: 5. What is the following an example of: "The cat and bat sat in a hat"?
questions.explanation: rhyme (vần) là các từ kết thúc bằng âm giống nhau.

questions.content: 6. Which of the following could be urgent?
questions.explanation: An emergency phone call (cuộc gọi khẩn cấp) là việc cấp bách (urgent).

questions.content: 7. What happens when a couple gets divorced?
questions.explanation: Khi ly hôn (divorced), họ không còn kết hôn nữa.

questions.content: 8. How would you creep?
questions.explanation: creep (bò, trườn, đi rón rén) thường thực hiện một cách chậm rãi (slowly).

questions.content: 9. Which of the following would you pat?
questions.explanation: Bạn thường vỗ nhẹ (pat) một chú chó để âu yếm.

questions.content: 10. What could come from nowhere?
questions.explanation: Một ý tưởng (idea) có thể xuất hiện đột ngột từ hư không (from nowhere).

word_list_exercises.title: Exercise 3: Choose the word that is the better fit for each blank.

questions.content: 1. I asked my mom ________ where she was going. She told me she was going ________. (aloud / nowhere)
questions.explanation: aloud (lớn tiếng) phù hợp với 'asked' (hỏi), nowhere (không đi đâu) phù hợp với 'going' (đi).

questions.content: 2. The ________ has perfect skin without any scars or ________. (infant / wrinkles)
questions.explanation: infant (trẻ sơ sinh) có làn da hoàn hảo không có wrinkles (nếp nhăn).

questions.content: 3. After my parents got ________, I was sad about my dad's ________ around the house. (absence / divorced)
questions.explanation: divorced (ly hôn) đi với bố mẹ, absence (sự vắng mặt) đi với sự hiện diện của người bố.

questions.content: 4. My boss asked me to ________ the image for her customers. She said it was very ________. (urgent / reproduce)
questions.explanation: reproduce (tái tạo, sao chép) hình ảnh, và việc đó rất urgent (cấp bách).

questions.content: 5. After I fell, I ________ on my finger where I cut it. Then my mom ________ me on the back and told me to get up. (sucked / patted)
questions.explanation: sucked (mút) ngón tay bị đứt, mẹ patted (vỗ nhẹ) vào lưng.

questions.content: 6. The ________ man on television entertained viewers by saying ________. (bald / rhymes)
questions.explanation: người đàn ông bald (hói đầu) giải trí bằng cách nói rhymes (vần điệu).

questions.content: 7. Manuel's mom thought he had ________, but in reality he had just ________ under his bed. (crept / vanished)
questions.explanation: mẹ tưởng cậu bé đã vanished (biến mất), nhưng thực ra cậu vừa crept (lẻn) dưới gầm giường.

questions.content: 8. I was scared when my big sister left me in the ________. I was afraid someone would ________ me. (wagon / kidnap)
questions.explanation: để lại trong wagon (xe kéo), sợ ai đó sẽ kidnap (bắt cóc).

questions.content: 9. It was such a ________ to be finished with the long exam. I was so tired afterward that I needed to take a ________. (nap / relief)
questions.explanation: hoàn thành bài thi là một sự relief (nhẹ nhõm), quá mệt nên cần một nap (giấc ngủ ngắn).

questions.content: 10. Nellie wrapped a ________ around her and made funny sounds. She was ________ a ghost. (imitating / blanket)
questions.explanation: quấn blanket (chăn) và imitating (bắt chước) một con ma.

questions.content:
Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.
1. Anna took care of Grace in her mother's absence because her parents got a divorce.
questions.explanation: Đúng (T).

questions.content: 2. Grace had a lot of hair and wrinkles.
questions.explanation: Sai (F). Câu sửa lại: Grace was bald and had no wrinkles.

questions.content: 3. Anna imitated a cat, and Grace reproduced the sounds she made.
questions.explanation: Đúng (T).

questions.content: 4. Anna had nowhere to go with the wagon.
questions.explanation: Đúng (T).

questions.content: 5. When Anna came back from her room, she found that the infant had been kidnapped.
questions.explanation: Sai (F). Câu sửa lại: When Anna came back from her room, she found that Grace had vanished.

questions.content: 6. Anna sang rhymes for Grace to try to find her more quickly.
questions.explanation: Sai (F). Câu sửa lại: Anna called aloud for Grace to find her.

questions.content:
Part B: Answer the questions.
1. What did Anna feel when she finally found Grace?
questions.explanation: Anna cảm thấy nhẹ nhõm (Relief) khi tìm thấy Grace.

questions.content: 2. How did Grace get under the bed?
options: Anna put her there for her nap.
Anna carried her in the blanket.
questions.explanation: Grace đã lén bò xuống đó (crept under the bed).

questions.content: 3. Which is NOT something Anna did with Grace?
questions.explanation: Đọc sách to không phải là việc Anna đã làm với Grace.

questions.content: 4. Why did Anna wrap Grace in a blanket?
options: So she could take a nap
To keep her from sucking her thumb
questions.correctAnswer: So she could take a nap
questions.explanation: Anna quấn chăn cho Grace để cô bé có thể ngủ trưa (take a nap).
